name: MCSR6N2
tagline: 13th Gen Intel U-series six-port appliance with DDR4
description: MCSR6N2 offers Intel U300 / Core i3-1315U / i5-1335U / i7-1355U, up to 64GB DDR4, six Intel i226-V 2.5GbE ports and DC 12–19V input. HDMI, DisplayPort and Type-C provide display connectivity; exact display versions and resolutions require confirmation.

specs.label: Graphics
specs.value: 13th Intel Integrated Graphics/Intel Iris Xe Graphics

specs.label: Display
specs.value: HDMI + DisplayPort + Type-C (data and display); connector revisions and resolutions require confirmation

specs.label: Power
specs.value: DC12-19V wide voltage Supply(5.5 x 2.5 mm)

specs.label: Expansion
specs.value: M.2 E-Key WiFi socket can be converted to; M.2 NVMe hard drive signal with an available expansion board.

specs.label: BIOS
specs.value: Supports power-on sele-test, GPIO, wake-on-LAN features

specs.label: Front I/O
specs.value: 1 x Power Button; 1 x HDMI; 1 x DP; 1 x Type-C (data & display); 1 x CLR-CMOS Button; 2 x USB 3.0; 2 x USB 3.2; 1 x TF card

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 1 x DC12-19V Power interface; 6 x Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet port; 1 x Hard disk indicator; 1 x Power indicator

specs.label: Internal I/O
specs.value: 2 x SO-DIMM DDR4 memory slots; 1 x M.2 Wi-Fi header (expandable NVMe signals); 1 x M.2 NVMe x4 header; 1 x buzzer; 1 x 4-pin power header; 1 x 12 V CPU fan 4-pin header; 1 x COM header; 1 x USB header; 1 x 2-pin non-standard SATA connector; 1 x F-PANEL header

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 1 x M.2 NVMex4; 2 x SATA (Unstandard 12 Pin 2.5-inch Interface)
